policy.purpose: Authoritative library of installable firmware payloads; component identity never implies payload identity.
policy.installation: PCB Editor manually selects a compatible payload and installs a copy into a machine-local PCB instance.
policy.mutation: Runtime writes never modify the global Firmware Store.
policy.simulation_authenticity: When component behavior originates from stored program/configuration, VMB should consume/execute the same payload whenever technically possible. Any bypass must be explicit and may not erase the payload artifact.
policy.reverse_delivery: Payloads required to realize physical component behavior are emitted with manufacturing/CAD outputs and bound to the exact board instance/component plus hash.
policy.bypass_rule: A simulation bypass never makes a payload optional for reverse physical delivery; bypass status must be explicit in the board/load contract.
policy.identity: Silicon/component identity never implies payload identity unless the exact factory-programmed order code is itself the selected physical identity.
